name: Advanced Deep Learning for Physics
description:
This course will give a practical and comprehensive introduction of deep learning in the context of physical simulations. Beyond standard supervised learning from data, we’ll look at physical loss constraints, more tightly coupled learning algorithms with differentiable simulations, as well as reinforcement learning and improved gradient calculations. These methods have a significant potential to fundamentally change what computer simulations can achieve. As much as possible, the topics will come with hands-on code examples and exercises. 

More information at: https://www.in.tum.de/cg/teaching/summer-term-22/advanced-deep-learning-for-physics/
